The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3dae0156982e5d20), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Consider any of the fixed separated arrangements above, including arrangements enlarged by reflected copies. Let Yδ = Hδ(f), where f is a real smooth zero-integral test supported in a disk having a filled cut-search neighborhood disjoint from all Ui. For every 1 ≤ p < ∞, E  |Yδ|p | Ploc  ≤ Cp (5.9) for all sufficiently small δ. The constants are uniform on compact families of such arrangements with positive clearances and bounded smooth test norms. The same holds for finite collections of these tests and, by separating real and imaginary parts, for complex tests.
